name: Beverly Harrison
bio:
Beverly Harrison's career began not on the racetrack, but in a Detroit automotive factory, where she honed her sharp eye for detail and unwavering commitment to quality. After two decades ensuring assembly lines ran smoothly and vehicles met exacting standards, a chance encounter with a Formula Motorsport International team member at a local car show sparked a passion for motorsports. Recognizing the critical role of quality control in high-stakes racing, she made the transition, bringing her experience and perfectionist tendencies to Rexal FMI Racing.

Beverly approaches her role with a methodical and pragmatic mindset. She believes in preventative measures, rigorous testing, and meticulous documentation to ensure every component and process meets the highest standards. Her innovation score comes from an ability to find unexpected, yet effective, solutions to complex problems. Beverly's dedication to eliminating errors and maximizing performance makes her an indispensable asset to the team, even if her relentless pursuit of perfection can sometimes ruffle feathers.

physical.description: Beverly is a woman of medium height, with a no-nonsense posture that conveys her unwavering focus.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously recording observations and measurements.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deeply focused.
Insists on using a specific brand of blue painter's tape for marking components.
